# jpegli legacy fixtures

Streams written by this package's encoder as released in jpegs v0.2.0,
before it became T.81 conformant. That encoder wrote 16 appended bits after
the SSSS=16 Huffman code (T.81 H.1.2.2 says none), and predictors 5 and 6
used truncating `/2` instead of an arithmetic shift. Files in this format
exist in the wild, so `Decode` retries a 16-bit stream with the frozen legacy
decoder (`legacy.go`) when the conformant decode fails.

Each `<name>.jpg` has its source image `<name>.pgm`. They were generated by
`generate.go.txt` (a `main` package built against jpegs v0.2.0, seed 356) and
each was checked to round-trip through the v0.2.0 decoder. The `ssss16-*`
streams contain SSSS=16 differences, so libjpeg-turbo `djpeg` does not
reproduce their source images; `random16-*` and `gradient8-*` do not, so they
are also valid T.81 streams.
